name: smwmusic-boot-hill-player
title: Boot Hill - Player 1 Dies
description:
A tune that plays when player 1 is getting shot in an Arcade game called Boot Hill. Styled after Super Mario World's death theme. The origin is Chopin's Piano Sonata No.2 Op. 35 (Funeral March/Marche funèbre/Marsz żałobny), which you've very likely heard before, but may've not known its name, and also played in a couple video games.

Naturally, could be used as a death theme. The TXT file also includes info on how to enable SMW's death SFX.
